company.name: Stratum VDC & MEP Engineering
company.tagline: ISO 9001:2015 Certified | Turnkey MEP Design & Multi-Trade Coordination Solutions Across India & Globally

hero.title: MEP Engineering
hero.subtitle: Stratum designs mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems for buildings across India.

projects.title: Office Campus
projects.description: Plan the cooling plant and main power distribution together. Allow space above ceilings for ducts, lighting and sprinkler pipes.

projects.title: Residential Towers
projects.description: Divide water supply into pressure zones. Align the vertical routes for pipes and cables with the floor plans.

projects.title: Hospital
projects.description: Separate ventilation for clinical spaces from the rest of the building. Identify which rooms and equipment need backup power.

projects.title: Logistics Warehouse
projects.description: Set sprinkler layouts around storage rack heights and aisle widths. Plan ventilation around loading areas and work zones.

projects.title: Data Centre
projects.description: Plan cooling and power for the equipment load. Work out which systems need a backup if the primary equipment goes offline.

projects.title: Underground Station
projects.description: Coordinate station ventilation and smoke control with the station layout and passenger escape routes.

services.title: Mechanical/HVAC Design
services.summary: Air conditioning, heating, ventilation, and cooling loads.
services.scope: We size equipment and plan air and water distribution around the building layout and operating needs.

services.title: Electrical Design
services.summary: Power distribution, lighting, and backup systems.
services.scope: We use the load list and architectural plans to lay out distribution boards, circuits, lighting, and backup power.

services.title: Plumbing Design
services.summary: Water supply, sanitary drainage, and stormwater systems.
services.scope: We size supply and drainage networks using the fixture schedule, building layout, and available utility connections.

services.title: MEP 3D Modeling Services
services.summary: 3D models of building services for design and coordination.
services.scope: We model the ducts, pipes, equipment, and cable routes in the agreed scope and follow the project’s model conventions.

services.title: Point Cloud to 3D CAD
services.summary: Models of existing spaces and services from survey scans.
services.scope: We use the supplied point cloud to trace the systems and building elements defined in the scope. We flag areas the scan cannot show clearly.

services.title: PDF to CAD Drafting
services.summary: Editable CAD drawings from PDF plans and details.
services.scope: We redraw the supplied sheets, set up layers and units, and check the result against known dimensions.
deliverables: A list of dimensions to confirm

services.title: Clash Detection & Coordination
services.summary: Find conflicts between building systems, structure, and architecture.
services.scope: We combine the project models, check the agreed coordination zones, and log conflicts so each team can resolve its items.
deliverables: Clash reports with locations and owners

services.title: Quantity Takeoff Services
services.summary: Material counts and measurements for estimating.
services.scope: We measure from the drawing or model revision your team provides and record the assumptions behind each quantity.

services.title: Component Library Creation
services.summary: Reusable parametric components for project models.
services.scope: We build families from product information, with geometry, connectors, and parameters appropriate for the project.

services.title: Shop Drawings
services.summary: Installation drawings based on the coordinated design.
services.scope: We develop the agreed service layouts into sheets with the dimensions and references the site team needs.

services.title: QA/QC Services
services.summary: Drawing and model checks before issue.
services.scope: We review the agreed files for coordination, completeness, and consistency with the project requirements.
deliverables: Issue log with items to resolve

services.title: Structural Drafting Services
services.summary: Structural drawings from engineering designs and markups.
services.scope: We turn engineer-provided information into coordinated plans, sections, and details for the agreed drawing set.

services.title: Architectural Drafting Services
services.summary: Architectural drawings from sketches, models, and markups.
services.scope: We prepare or update the drawing set using the architect’s design, dimensions, and drafting standards.

services.title: 3D Rendering
services.summary: Still images to communicate how a proposed space will look.
services.scope: We use your drawings or model to set up materials, lighting, and camera views for the agreed spaces.

services.title: Fire Protection Design
services.summary: Sprinkler, hydrant, fire alarm, and smoke-control design.
services.scope: We review the building plans and project requirements, then lay out the systems in scope and prepare drawings for review.
deliverables: Pump and tank sizing where required

careers.title: Senior MEP Coordination Engineer (Navisworks & AutoCAD)
careers.description: Lead multi-disciplinary clash detection matrices in Navisworks Manage, coordinate between HVAC, PHE, Fire, and Electrical sub-teams, manage BCF issue trackers, and ensure LOD 400-500 model compliance per client EIR.

careers.title: Lead HVAC & Thermal Design Engineer
careers.description: Responsible for primary HVAC DBR generation, HAP hourly load simulations, chiller plant hydraulic calculations, duct sizing, ventilation pressurization per NBC 2016, and ECBC energy compliance validation.

careers.title: Senior Electrical & Substation Design Engineer
careers.description: Perform ETAP power system analysis, 11kV/33kV indoor/outdoor substation layout design, DG sizing, IS 3043 earthing grid calculations, lightning protection risk assessment (IS/IEC 62305), and SLD preparations.

careers.title: QA/QC & Quantity Takeoff Engineer
careers.description: Verify engineering drawings against CPWD specifications, perform model audit checklists, extract itemized BOQ/BOM for tender schedules, and validate good-for-construction (GFC) spool deliverables.
